about: A cave-crawl treasure hunt through underground caverns. A wizard says the treasures lie south of the ravine: pearls behind a riddling stone door, the rest past a spinning room. A dragon and a unicorn are also about.

done.why: After about 17 turns I was still only wandering with no clear next step. The wizard's hint was the only hook, and the dragon looked like a gamble. I quit, as an impatient player would.

moments.note: The wizard appeared, made me drop the lamp, and told me where the treasure is.
The Carousel Room is a nice idea: a spinning room with eight passages, and a hint about stopping it.
The dragon warns me not to strike again, but I have no clear goal here.

wished: A clearer first goal or nudge
To find the stone door with the question

lines.line: It is all south of the ravine, his look says, every treasure the Empire mislaid, and much good may it do you
lines.why: This gave a goal, and it was the only hook I had.

lines.line: The floor, if you stand still on it a moment, is turning, slowly, and the eight passages go round with it

fun.why: Classic cave exploration with some nice touches, but nothing grabbed me.

engagement.why: I drifted with no pull, so I quit.

difficulty.why: I couldn't tell what to do next, but the early rooms were easy.

interestingness.why: The wizard's hints and the spinning room were interesting.

prose.why: The prose is evocative and the hints are woven into it well.
